comparison.objective: Sort cables onto color-matched hooks with both sides hanging; candidate breaks and collects four tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual matching and deformable cable draping versus small-tool alignment, bimanual impact regulation, withdrawal, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Each cable hangs from its matching hook and is released versus all four tangs fractured and contained with inserts and shell intact.
comparison.reason: Cable classification and draping test a different physical ability and terminal state. No spec versions or hanging thresholds are supplied.
